title: Utho Baba
body:
Haaye...
Haaye wo shaam e ghareeba'n
wo andheraa sehra..
jalte khaimo'n se chali ran ki taraf ek dukhiya
aag daaman mein thi, kaano se lahu jaari tha
baap ki laash pe aakar ye sakina ne kaha
kab se aawaz tumhe deti hu pyaare baba
mujhse pehle bhala tum so gaye kaise baba
<<MINI>>
utho baba..(4)
<<DIVIDER>>
shaame ghareeba'n mein tha sakina ka nauha
<<MINI>>
utho baba..(4)
<<DIVIDER>>
1. Mai karungi na tamacho'n ki kabhi tumse shikayat
kya nahi aapko baba apni beti se mohabbat
dekho puphi se aagaye milne ko dada
<<MINI>>
utho baba..(4)
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Tumko zehmat na ho patthar mai hata deti hu baba
zakhmi haatho'n se musalla mai banadeti hu baba
ho gaya ban mein waqt namaz e maghrib ka
<<MINI>>
utho baba..(4)
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Zakhm dukhte hai bohot mere sambhalo mujhe baba
apni aaghosh mein jaldi se chhupa lo mujhe baba
shimr ke darr se dam na nikal jaye mera
<<MINI>>
utho baba..(4)
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Khuld se aaye the jode ye kabhi maa se suna tha
chadar e aaj manga do baba ehsaan ye hoga
chinn gaya bann mein aapki behno ka parda
<<MINI>>
utho baba..(4)
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Tum se bichhdi thi mai kuch der to tooti ye qayamat
jaane kya hogayi hogi unki cheh maah mein haalat
paas tumhare banke mai aai hu sughra
<<MINI>>
utho baba..(4)
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Shimr ne maar ke durre usko jis waqt uthaya
piche mud mud ke takallum yehi kehti thi sakina
shaam chali hu ab na bachungi mai zindaa..
<<MINI>>
utho baba..(4)
